# Stephen P. Pryor, CPA

> Stephen P. Pryor, CPA is a Port Chester, New York CPA firm founded in 1990, serving Westchester County and clients across New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, and Florida. The firm supports construction, real estate, and hospitality businesses, with a specialty in bars and pubs, alongside individual tax clients. Its tagline, 'You run your business. We'll run your numbers,' reflects a hands-on advisory approach built on bundled fixed-fee services, real-time financial data, and year-round, relationship-driven support.
